Stays advanced on weak but positive evidence. Stays advanced. The campaign-level replication supports the core assumption: most independent hijack campaigns add an install-time hook that legitimate releases rarely add. It also confirms a blind spot, since about one in five classifiable campaigns only modified existing files. Before building anything, check whether vendors or registries already offer maintainer-side alerts.
Design pre-registered before data collection: pooled policy-closed group across GitHub (LLVM alone has too few), LLVM newcomer control, fixed decision thresholds.
